headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barça, Madrid believe Haaland could exit Man City next summer
description: Could LaLiga giants Barcelona and Real Madrid make a move for Manchester City star Erling Haaland next summer?Transfer talk has the latest.

headline: Liverpool's Andoni Iraola lauds Dominik Szoboszlai for 'worldie' in Tottenham win
description: Andoni Iraola has heaped praise on midfielder Dominik Szoboszlai after he scored a "worldie" in Liverpool's 3-1 victory over Tottenham Hotspur.

headline: Man United need wins after bad week of JJ Gabriel unrest, protests and derby drama
description: Things have gone from bad to worse this week for Man United, with defeats on and off the field. Victory against Brighton in midweek would go a long way to lifting the mood.

headline: Pro Ref chief Howard Webb: 'Tunnel vision' helped Erling Haaland goal to stand, Enzo Fernández offside missed
description: Referees' chief Howard Webb said "tunnel vision" from VAR Matt Donohue led to Manchester City's derby winner being allowed to stand -- but that the assistant VAR should have intervened.

headline: Man United wonderkid JJ Gabriel, 15, asks to leave club - sources
description: Manchester United wonderkid JJ Gabriel has asked to leave the club, sources have told ESPN.
